mechanism: Foscarnet can cause seizures and CNS toxicity, and combined with tranylcypromine (an MAOI with sympathomimetic properties) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonergic effects, and neurological complications.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor blood pressure closely, maintain adequate hydration to reduce foscarnet nephrotoxicity, and monitor for seizures and hypertensive symptoms.
